node.statement: Validated node 1.1 fixes epsilon_max^cb=e_it/2 and delta_max^cb=min(e_it/2,1/(2*(1+|K_disp|))); validated node 1.2 consequently establishes, for the present bounds 0<=epsilon<=epsilon_max^cb and 0<=delta<=delta_max^cb, the required inequality delta+epsilon<=e_it.
